biographyData.title: Biography
paragraphs: Hi, I’m Karthik Arige, a BTech Computer Science and Engineering student with a strong interest in software development and building impactful digital solutions. I enjoy turning ideas into efficient, scalable, and user-focused applications.
I believe great software goes beyond code — it’s about solving problems, improving experiences, and creating solutions that truly make a difference.

Whether I’m working on software systems, websites, mobile applications, or academic and personal projects, I bring curiosity, discipline, and a passion for learning to everything I build. I’m eager to grow as a developer and contribute to meaningful, real-world projects.
